title: Food trail
question: Where does a hungry group go when food lies in a line?
intervention: Follow one Sprinter group along the trail and inspect what it eats.
predictedTradeoff: Moving costs energy. Sprinters that follow the trail may find more sugar than those that stay, but the trail is finite.
confounds: The Water Garden also holds a thin background of sugar (0.02 per cell), so not every bite comes from the trail. Growth is a well-fed group, not an inherited change.

completion.journalStamp: Followed a group along a food trail
